name: Sol'Kanar
description: A Force of Nature from Dominaria, once a nature spirit of Khone, corrupted by Geyadrone Dihada and later a demon king of Corondor.

timeline.summary: Dakkon bests Sol'Kanar, banishes Chromium and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
timeline.quote: This released a massive energy blast that created the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor .

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dihada corrupts Sol'Kanar and sets about conquering Corondor.
timeline.quote: set about conquering Corondor

citation.text: "Geyadrone Dihada", section "Dihada's schemes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A healer brews a poppy poison created by Sol'Kanar that kills dozens of Scarzam dragons, and Sivitri leaves Dominaria for other conquests.
timeline.quote: Dozens of the creatures were killed before Sivitri

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Sivitri's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gydolien Mor and Chondeah summon the last Scarzam dragon with Sivitri riding it; she attacks Sol'Kanar.
timeline.quote: she attacked the Swamp King

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gydolien takes control of Sivitri's dragon, which returns through the portal with Sivitri; Sol'Kanar orders Gydolien's home Khone scoured.
timeline.quote: Gydolien intervened by taking control of Sivitri's dragon, instructing it to leave.

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sivitri raids southeastern Corondor with dragons until poppy poison from Sol'Kanar kills the Scarzam Dragons and she leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Before Sivitri, astride the last and largest Scarzam Dragon, dozens of creatures were killed, leaving Dominaria for other planar conquests.

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Sivitri's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dihada twists Sol'Kanar into her minion, turns Khone into a swamp, and he wages war in her name.
timeline.quote: She turned Khone into a large swamp

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Minion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dakkon defeats Sol'Kanar, whom Dihada then discards as she tricks Dakkon into becoming her champion.
timeline.quote: He was defeated by Dakkon

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Minion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar moves to Sulgh and becomes its leader, demanding annual tribute.
timeline.quote: became the undisputed leader of the land

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar, Chondeah and Gydolien summon a Scarzam Dragon ridden by Sivitri, who attacks him; Gydolien forces them back and Sol'Kanar destroys Khone in a rage.
timeline.quote: destroyed the kingdom of Khone in a rage

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise interrupts the Lord of House Khone's war council, and together they bind Sol'Kanar the Swamp King.
timeline.quote: Together, they summoned and bound Sol’Kanar the Swamp King

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise appears at the Lord of Khone's war council and the two summon and bind Sol'Kanar the Swamp King.
timeline.quote: Freyalise and the Lord of Khone summon Sol'Kanar the Swamp King and bind him.

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "The Swamp King , by D. G. Chichester". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone Dihada summons a powerful Cosmic Horror to sack Sedouris after Sol'Kanar's five-year siege.
timeline.quote: to sack the city of Sedouris on Corondor after Sol'Kanar the Swamp King had held the city under siege for five years.

citation.text: "Horror", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sol'kanar the Swamp King taunts Stangg.
timeline.quote: Suck on it, Stangg!

citation.text: Wordmail (Unhinged, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After weeks of searching, Ulf finds a mildewed book about Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor, and Dihada's curse.
timeline.quote: Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Dihada returns with Sol'Kanar and two Elder Dragons; Dakkon slays Sol'Kanar and banishes Chromium.
timeline.quote: Dakkon slew Sol’Kanar and banished Chromium

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar submerges the caravan path between Khone and Shikar and uses it as leverage to demand tribute.
timeline.quote: By deliberately submerging this critical trade artery beneath the waters of his swamp

citation.text: "Date of Tribute", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Khone and Shikar must send regular offerings under threat of destruction, and are called the Contrary Kingdoms.
timeline.quote: the two kingdoms were compelled to send regular offerings directly to him

citation.text: "Date of Tribute", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The tribute becomes one spellcaster per realm; Gydolien Mor and Chondaeh are sent into Sol'Kanar's service, precipitating the Dragon War.
timeline.quote: Their involvement directly precipitated the outbreak of the Dragon War

citation.text: "Date of Tribute", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar sides with treacherous Khone in the Dragon War and destroys the city of Shikar.
timeline.quote: Sol'Kanar took the side of treacherous Khone, and destroyed the city of Shikar

citation.text: "Great Salt Marsh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dihada twists Khone into a swamp and binds its spirit as Sol'Kanar.
timeline.quote: until it was twisted into a swamp by Geyadrone Dihada and its spirit was bound to her service as Sol'Kanar the Swamp King

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After five years of siege by Sol'Kanar, Dihada summons a Cosmic Horror to eradicate Sedouris.
timeline.quote: Dihada summoned a Cosmic Horror to eradicate the inhabitants of the city

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar forces the kingdoms to send tribute until the Dragon War.
timeline.quote: forced the inhabitants to send slaves and goods on the Date of Tribute

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chondaeh boils the swamp, killing everyone in Khone but Gydolien Mor; Sol'Kanar retreats.
timeline.quote: killing everyone there, with Gydolien Mor as the only survivor

citation.text: "Khone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone Dihada corrupts the maro-sorcerer Sol'Kanar into a monster to better serve her.
timeline.quote: was corrupted into a monster by the planeswalker Geyadrone Dihada

citation.text: "Maro-Sorcerer", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An aged healer finds a new poppy created by Sol'Kanar that makes a poison killing Scarzam Dragons.
timeline.quote: the poppies became an incredibly potent contact poison that could kill the Scarzam Dragons

citation.text: "Sivitri's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone Dihada corrupts Sol'Kanar, making the poppies disappear, then sets the Forging of the Blackblade in action.
timeline.quote: Geyadrone Dihada showed up on Dominaria and corrupted Sol'Kanar

citation.text: "Sivitri's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulf finds a lost tome on Sol'Kanar and Thranegeld advises him to keep it hidden.
timeline.quote: Thranegeld advised Ulf to keep it hidden and not to trust anyone else with its contents

citation.text: "Thranegeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Docent Thranegeld tasks Ulf with a research project on Corondor; Ulf finds an ancient tome about the curse of Sol'Kanar, attracting Phyrexian attention.
timeline.quote: Ulf discovered an ancient, forgotten tome that detailed the curse of Sol'Kanar

citation.text: "Ulf", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Cursed him and made him her demonic servant.
